note: Made-up prices for practice, not a real market. The same every time, so a chart can be compared with an earlier attempt.

regimes.label: Choppy / range-bound
regimes.note: Price drifts sideways in a band, so the edges of the range are where the levels are.

regimes.label: Strong uptrend
regimes.note: Price grinds steadily upward, so pullbacks are shallow and the highs keep being taken out.

regimes.label: Volatile, with a crash
regimes.note: Large daily swings and a sharp fall in the middle, so ordinary movement is wide and stops need room.
